title: Event-Driven Lambda with SQS Triggers and Batch Processing
title_es: Lambda Event-Driven con Triggers SQS y Batch Processing
description: Runnable companion for the SQS-triggered Lambda recipe: batch handler with partial batch responses, producer helpers, SAM template with DLQ and CloudWatch alarm, and scheduled queue draining.
description_es: Proyecto ejecutable complementario de la receta de Lambda con triggers SQS: handler por lotes con partial batch responses, helpers de productor, template SAM con DLQ y alarma CloudWatch, y drenado programado de la cola.
